semiconductor_relevance: High — Primionics provides specialized test and measurement solutions crucial for semiconductor device validation and characterization.
summary: Primionics Pvt. Ltd. offers engineering technologies focused on electronic test, industrial automation, and embedded computing within the semiconductor value chain. Their product portfolio includes electronic, RF, power, and automated measurement platforms, as well as PCIe interconnect solutions and embedded security tools, catering to the development and validation of semiconductor devices.
